definition.name: Fan
definition.description: The motor turns the blades to move air. The controls decide when it runs.

terminals.label: L
terminals.purpose: Line brings power to the fitting. Its usual marking is L.

terminals.label: N
terminals.purpose: Neutral carries current back to the supply while the load is on.

terminals.label: PE
terminals.purpose: Earth connection for the fitting. The earth path stays connected when the switch opens.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The case holds the working parts in place and keeps them apart.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: Lift the cover on the bench to see the connections underneath.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: A clamp holds the bare end of a wire against the metal terminal.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: These keep the fitting in place. Look for the screws or clips that hold it.

parts.name: Rotor and shaft
parts.purpose: The rotor is the part that turns. The shaft carries that movement to the machine.

parts.name: Windings
parts.purpose: These coils of wire create a magnetic field when current flows.

parts.name: Control board
parts.purpose: The board takes signals in and controls the outputs. The bench shows what the board does at its terminals.

terminals.label: L
terminals.purpose: The timer feeds the fan motor here.

terminals.label: N
terminals.purpose: The motor current returns to the supply through N.

data.detailPurpose: Four fixing holes hold the fan against the wall.
The duct fits over this round outlet at the back.
The fixed grille keeps the turning blades behind the spokes.
